account.del.d: Your account, your verified wallet and your subscription will be erased. You have seven days to change your mind — after that, nothing can be recovered.

account.id.how: You are never asked for a password or a key: your VeVe wallet is custodial, you cannot sign anything. The proof is a GESTURE — you list two of your collectibles for sale, the chain shows it publicly, then you cancel.
account.id.leaves: This button takes you to id.digitalcollectible.net. You arrive already signed in, and you come back here afterwards.
account.id.title: Link your VeVe wallet
account.id.who: VeVe ID is a service independent from VeVePrice. It checks that a VeVe wallet belongs to you, and it provides that same service to several sites. VeVePrice only ever sees the answer: yes or no.
account.lead: Your tier, your address and your wallet. Nothing is shared, nothing is resold.
